answer: Admission locks 54 POA per identity, refunded slowly over 14 epochs and forfeited on any grading conviction. A farm of 900 aliases must park 48600 POA it cannot touch, so the attack pays rent on its own fraud while honest agents pay nothing in the end. The jetty is the check that cannot be faked, the echo is the price the attacker pays, and the horizon is the record that outlives the epoch.
